coverage.method: Read every Lua/Perl source for mechanical/event signatures; manually inspected candidate bodies, NPC event registrations, launchers and scripted stage data. Every encounters-directory module is either a candidate or an explicit helper/duplicate/nonencounter exclusion. Ordinary dialogue, merchants, turn-ins, kill credit and generic NPC race modifiers are excluded. Clear means source-backed candidate, not live or database-activation verification.
